answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to commit verifiable capital to participate in network consensus. Unlike a fable of decentralization where identity is cheap, this system ensures that an echo of authority corresponds to locked assets. The cost of an attack is the zephyr of market volatility paired with the guaranteed loss of staked collateral, which renders the creation of countless malicious identities economically prohibitive for any rational actor.
